findings.title: Static SQL variants escape detection, including mixed writes and unknown targets
findings.criterion: Q13 SPEC addendum requires detecting UPDATE/DELETE, other writes in CTE/mixed statements, comment variants and refusing unknown-target exemptions.
findings.observed: Every listed probe returns exit0/PASS/findings[] despite explicit static domain DML or dynamic target. The UPDATE pattern only admits an unquoted alias and SQL -- comments are not normalized. This is not constructed SQL uncertainty.
findings.neededCorrection: Recognize quoted aliases and normalize SQL comments in SQL content; fail closed when a write is recognized but target/grammar is unresolved. Preserve exact unqualified quota-table allowance and UPSERT DO UPDATE SET handling.
neededNegatives: Allowed quota INSERT followed by UPDATE billing_items AS "b" SET value=$2
WITH changed AS (UPDATE billing_items AS "b" SET value=$1 RETURNING id) INSERT INTO api_rate_limit_buckets SELECT id FROM changed

DELETE -- comment
FROM billing_items WHERE id=$1

findings.title: Host string content is stripped as comments, hiding subsequent domain writes
findings.criterion: Comment variants must not mask following forbidden effects.
findings.observed: const endpoint="https://example.invalid"; client.query(`DELETE FROM billing_items WHERE id=$1`) returns exit0/PASS/findings[]. Regex treats // inside the quoted URL as a source comment and removes the rest of the line.
findings.neededCorrection: Make host-comment removal aware of quoted strings/template literals and escapes; preserve string contents that contain URLs/comment markers.
neededNegatives: Benign URL literal followed on same line by clinical/financial/agendamento INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE
Quoted // or /*...*/ text must not swallow a following forbidden call
Preserve positive actual comments, harmless URL constants and quota UPSERT

findings.title: Production sources are omitted when a directory name contains .test. or .spec.
findings.criterion: New tracked/untracked source files inside the same governed prefixes must be inventoried; only actual test files should be excluded.
findings.observed: apps/api/src/new.test.helper/domain.ts containing DELETE FROM billing_items returns exit0/PASS/scannedFiles0 in both tracked and untracked fixtures. ignoredName tests the whole path rather than a defined test filename classification.
findings.neededCorrection: Restrict exclusion to precisely classified test files (anchored basename/suffix); do not exempt unrelated ancestor directories merely containing .test./.spec.
neededNegatives: Tracked and untracked production .ts/.js files beneath .test./.spec.-containing directories must be scanned/rejected
Genuine example.test.ts remains excluded; ordinary untracked worker SQL remains rejected

observations.exceptionNarrowing: Exact file+literal quota table is correctly enforced for recognized simple writes; quoted/schema-qualified quota targets rejected. Existing replay exceptions preserved.
observations.inventory: Ordinary untracked source detected; Git inventory failure rejects; test-substring path omission remains.
observations.positiveControls: Quota UPSERT and ordinary quota alias, actual comments, benign URL, diagnostic prose and genuine test exclusion remain accepted in independent fixtures. No actual-current-source false positive established.
